docs: Slotbook: a verifiable, disputable record-date holder register for permissioned
SPL tokens. Use cases UC-1 to UC-14 and decisions D1 to D22 are in the scope lock;
the snapshot format is docs/SNAPSHOT_SPEC.md.

accounts.name: holder
docs: Must be the leaf owner (D10).

accounts.name: pending
docs: Created in the handler only when the holder's account is not transferable,
because Anchor cannot init on one branch.

accounts.name: holder_mint_account
docs: The holder's associated token account of the permissioned mint; read for freeze state.
It must be the ATA: with any account of theirs, a holder with one frozen and one
thawed account could pass the thawed one and skip Pending.

accounts.name: vault
docs: init_if_needed: anyone can create an ATA for any address, so a plain `init`
could be blocked by someone creating this vault first.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The permissioned Token-2022 mint being registered.

accounts.name: bond_mint
docs: Bonds are paid in this mint (D9, devnet USDC).

accounts.name: bond_vault
docs: init_if_needed: anyone can create an ATA for any address, so a plain `init`
could be blocked by someone creating this vault first.

accounts.name: commitment
docs: Closes to the Attestor account, like a commitment voided in resolve_challenge,
so every commitment's rent reaches the attestor the same way: at withdraw_bond.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Receives the Pending rent (D11).

accounts.name: holder_mint_account
docs: The holder's associated token account (see Claim), so a thawed side account cannot
release a payout held for a frozen holder.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The resolver, or any cranker for Ruling::Expired.

accounts.name: challenge
docs: Present for an owner challenge; absent for a root conflict (D3).

accounts.name: challenger
docs: Receives the Challenge rent; must equal challenge.challenger.

accounts.name: challenger_bond_account
docs: Challenger's bond-mint account; owner checked in the handler.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Receives the Pending rent (D11).

types.name: Attestor
docs: ["attestor", issuer_config, attestor]. Closed by withdraw_bond.

types.name: Backend
docs: Reconstruction backend an attestor declares. Matches the manifest `backend` byte.

types.name: Challenge
docs: ["challenge", distribution, index_u32_le]. Closed at resolution, rent to challenger (D1).

fields.name: owner
docs: Pubkey::default() disputes register_total (D22).

types.name: ClaimReceipt
docs: ["claim", distribution, owner]. Never closed; blocks a second claim.

types.name: CommitArgs
docs: Data an attestor commits (UC-4). Mirrors the manifest (spec section 11).

types.name: Commitment
docs: ["commitment", distribution, attestor]. Closed at resolve or release_attestor (D8).

types.name: DisputeKind
docs: Why a distribution is Disputed (D3): an owner challenge, or attestor roots that differ.

types.name: Distribution
docs: ["distribution", issuer_config, id_u64_le]. Never closed; Closed is terminal (D7).
Owns the distribution vault.

types.name: DistributionState
docs: Distribution lifecycle. See the brief, section 4.

types.name: IssuerConfig
docs: ["issuer", mint]. Never closed (D18). Owns the bond vault.

types.name: IssuerParams
docs: Parameters set at init_issuer and replaced by update_issuer (D18, D19).

types.name: Pending
docs: ["pending", distribution, owner]. A frozen holder's payout, held (D10, D11).

types.name: Ruling
docs: Resolver ruling for resolve_challenge (D3, D4, D5, D17).

constants.name: MAX_PROOF_DEPTH
docs: Merkle proofs are bounded before the loop (D13, spec section 8).
